versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E), the Dcm module shall check if the DID has a Write access configured (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidWrite in DcmDspDidInfo ). If not, the Dcm module shall send NRC 0x31 (Request out of range).
